input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need this fixed as soon as possible. Can you help?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Please let me know what you need me to do next to get my internet speed back to excellent.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said "No Connection." What should I do next?
My phone currently shows that Airplane Mode is ON. What should I do next?
I’ve turned Airplane Mode off. Now, my status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, and mobile data is disabled. What should I do next?
Mobile data is now enabled. The status bar still shows a poor signal and 2G network, and I also noticed that Data Saver is on. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Data Saver mode. The status bar still shows a poor signal and 2G network, with mobile data enabled. What should I do next?
I’ve changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G Preferred. Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength, 5G network, and mobile data is enabled. Should I try running a speed test again?
I tried running the speed test again, but it still failed and says "No Connection." What should I do next?
I’d like to add 2GB of data to my line. Please confirm the total price and proceed with the refill. I do not want to change my plan—just add the extra data for now.
Yes, please go ahead and add 2GB of data to my line for $4.00. Let me know once it’s done so I can try the speed test again.
I tried running the speed test again after the data refill, but it still says "No Connection." What should I do next?
I checked my SIM card status, and it shows as active and working. What should I do next?
My current APN name is set to "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Nothing looks obviously wrong to me. What should I do next?

I reset the APN settings, rebooted my phone, and tried the speed test again, but it still says "No Connection." This is getting frustrating—what else can we try? I really need excellent internet speed.
###TRANSFER###
